source: arXiv:1610.00278v1 Section2 and Appendix C: necessary finite-chain dependencies for comparison of original physical algebraic multiplicity with analytic determinant order.
phase: Exact finite physical chain/root-space equivalence, polynomial forcing, powered analytic jet remainders and injective two-mode chain coordinates

domains.generic: Complex modules with an injective actual domain inclusion; every finite chain length N including0.
domains.physical: The unchanged original period-two H1 domain and original H-minus-one base space, with the actual singular Hill pencil L-lambda*J at every step.
domains.potential: Every complex original endpoint potential of order-r,0<=r<1/2. Real mean-zero physically period-one source potentials are included.
domains.norm_and_topology: All analytic reconstruction remainders use the full original H1 Banach norm; finite physical root spaces are not replaced by an arbitrary bounded operator.
domains.spectral: Finite-chain equivalence, polynomial forcing, finite dimensionality and eventual multiplicity hold for every complex lambda. Reduced/reconstruction germs use the corrected6n strip and existing cutoff; actual determinant zeros are automatically interior.

exact_chain_model.coefficients: v_0,...,v_(N-1) in original H1, stored in Taylor order.
exact_chain_model.recurrence: P*v_0=0 and P*v_j=J*v_(j-1), P=L-lambda0*J. The empty coefficient function is included.
exact_chain_model.reconstruction_germ: f(t)-F(lambda0+t)*C*f(t)=t^N*H_H1(t), with H_H1 analytic in original H1 at0.
exact_chain_model.finite_jet_injection: v maps to (C*v_j)_(j<N) injectively on every physical chain space at every allowed interior point.

results: For arbitrary complex modules, an injective original domain inclusion identifies each finite chain coefficient space linearly with the actual pencil root-space level by its last included vector. Empty chains are retained. No operator-domain assumptions are dropped.

A finite chain polynomial satisfies the affine pencil exactly with the chain-length monomial times the final included coefficient as its forcing, for every complex increment. For the singular Hill operator all polynomial coefficients belong to original H1 and the forcing is the identical original H-minus-one distribution of endpoint data.

Physical finite H1 coefficient chain spaces are finite dimensional in the source endpoint range. Their dimensions eventually equal the actual original algebraic multiplicity by the exact root-space equivalence and the already proved finite stabilization.

The full inhomogeneous reduction gives analytic powered remainders for the actual reduced residual and original H1 reconstruction error of every finite chain. All their derivatives of order below the chain length vanish. The generic Banach-valued helper also recovers finite polynomial coefficients with exact factorial normalization.

The coefficientwise projection of every physical finite chain onto its two resonant modes is injective under the existing cutoff at interior strip points. The proof uses the full original H1 reconstruction germ and the vanishing polynomial coefficient theorem, without any inverse of the effective matrix.

Original complex source wrappers retain exact norm and distribution normalization. At every actual determinant zero the existing localization proves the required strict strip interior, so the finite-chain coordinate injectivity and reduced derivative vanishing need no extra interior premise.
remaining: Identify the projected coefficient jets explicitly with the existing formal matrix Taylor-kernel conditions.
Construct the converse map from every truncated formal effective-matrix kernel to a full original physical finite chain, retaining all domains.
Combine the resulting finite-level equivalence with eventual matrix Taylor nullity and scalar analytic order to prove physical algebraic multiplicity equals actual determinant order.
No algebraic bound2, semisimplicity or completion of any main theorem is claimed.
